critical_code_review_comments: ambiguity_gate.py is clean, pure, no I/O, testable — good extraction. Regex heuristic is intentionally cheap; risk of false positives on legitimate <4-word tasks with no quotes/paths (e.g. 'rebuild search index') exists but is acceptable per PRD (safer to ask than guess).

slo_metrics.py compute_slo: _percentile impl `int(len*pct)-1` is a simplistic index (nearest-rank-ish, no interpolation). Fine at large n; at very small n (e.g. n=1) p95 == p50. Documented as pragmatic; not a blocker.
AdminOverview SloCard handles met=null path cleanly (renders '—' + 'no samples' subtext) — verified live in DOM.

ChatPanel needs_clarification block correctly clears loopPending bubble, resets phase/tones/loopId, sets busy=false, and appends plain assistant bubble. Mirrors redirect_to_chat structure. No leaked state observed in live test.
SLO endpoint reuses same _require_admin pattern as /insights/dora — good consistency.
